title: Phase 3 execution, Layer 3: round 2 — verify the round-1 fixes, re-decide the stop

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST (declared before the spend). invoked_by: the standing continuation conduct. vehicle: the Workflow orchestration surface, attended side — host awake (the #775 incident's condition holds: dispatch only under a live session). round shape: VERIFY — each lens adversarially verifies the seven round-1 fixes (ff331dd9) in its scope, tries to refute each claim, sweeps the changed surfaces for regressions; the round re-decides the stop. domains, the same four (the fixes land on the same display surfaces): software-engineer (the unified fit path with protected tails, the digit-exact split, bounded_line's channel semantics, the canonical dedup), security (the terminal-boundary cleaning's coverage, the capped config read, the script's loud-degrade branch, the home fold in the broken path), quality-engineer (do the new falsifiers actually falsify — re-run the surviving-mutant checks against the grown suite; the emptied absences fixture; the per-fixture quantifiers), user-experience (the reworded degraded line as read, the breach line's wording, the identity-prefixed broken line's glance shape, the revised script guidance). MODEL, CHOSEN: claude-fable-5 all four. EFFORT, CHOSEN: software-engineer and security HIGH, quality-engineer and user-experience MEDIUM (unchanged posture). expected_cost_band: 0-12 findings pre-dedup, 200k-380k downstream tokens — priced from the verify-round history (Layer 2 observed 314k and 368k at four lenses; the two undercalls are the calibration evidence). inputs: the tree at the fix-pass boundary (ff331dd9 + the changelog mirror), the seven closed children, the #775 trail with the dispatch-incident record. returned + telemetry recorded here after.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 2 INTERIM (three of four lenses returned; the security lens died on a mid-response connection drop during the overnight run — a dead lens is never a clean verdict, so it is re-running under the resume mechanism with the three completed lenses cached; consolidation and children wait for it, since its scope covers exactly the surface where the others found the hole). Early picture: 20 of 21 returned verdicts held; two lenses independently CONFIRMED LIVE an incomplete #777 — the human form's composition line interpolates active_composition.scope and the domains list raw, leaking ESC and BEL to the terminal from a hostile state.yaml while every other value is cleaned (the fix's own fixture only exercised the phase field); the user-experience lens found the same class in broken.rs where diagnostic.message echoes state-sourced text verbatim into the broken human form. The quality lens ran a sixteen-mutant battery: two round-1 falsifiers do not falsify — the glued-mark mutant on the generic branch survives because the milestone field's spaced mark in the same line masks the containment check, and the machine report.degraded pin is single-kind where the criterion quantifies per registered kind — plus falsifiability minors (the degenerate-budget hard-cuts, the config cap, both #782 surfaces unpinned) and two overfit/hardcode nits. All three returned lenses refuse the stop. Cost so far: 558,392 downstream tokens including the overnight interruption retries — OVER the 200-380k band; the waste-versus-live split lands with the final telemetry once the security lens returns.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 2 COMPLETE, all four lenses (security re-ran clean from cache; the three others replayed). Verdict grid: 28 verdicts, 24 held, 4 incomplete — all four the SAME #777 hole (each lens found it in its scope: SE and UX the composition line, security the broken-state form and main.rs prints, all three the same class); no regression, no fix reversed. Stop: NOT reached, unanimous (all four refuse). Three children: #784 (major, three-lens convergent: #777 incomplete — clean_for_terminal reached render_segment and render_human's own interpolations but MISSED the human composition line's scope+domains, the broken-state human form's diagnostic.message/kind, and main.rs's registry/config eprintln diagnostics; live-confirmed ESC, BEL, TAB, and forged-newline injection from an adopter-edited state.yaml through ordinary vsdd status; machine and segment forms verified safe), #785 (major QE: two named round-1 falsifiers do not actually falsify — the glued-mark mutant survives the generic fit branch because the milestone field's correctly-spaced mark in the same rendered line satisfies the containment check, and the machine report.degraded pin is single-fixture where the criterion quantifies per registered kind), #786 (minor collector QE: the degenerate-budget hard-cuts, the config artifact cap, and both #782 surfaces have no falsifier; the generic-truncation test hardcodes the work-item budget; the human absence/fallback wordings are hardcoded parallels of registered/shared texts). TELEMETRY, chosen versus observed: model chosen=observed claude-fable-5 all four; effort chosen=observed (SE/security high, QE/UX medium); band DECLARED 200k-380k. OBSERVED, honestly split: the completing run of all four lenses was 412,823 tokens / 205 tools (over the ceiling by 9%, the verify-depth pattern); the earlier partial run that lost the security lens to a connection drop burned 558,392 more before the resume — TOTAL round cost ~971k, the great majority of it INTERRUPTION WASTE, not review depth. This is the third consecutive background dispatch mauled by host sleep or a mid-response drop (the #775 four-hour stall, the overnight partial here, now the security-lens drop). Conduct recommendation carried, not self-served: the durable fix is Layer 8's container-backed autonomous vehicle; until it exists, verify rounds should run only while the operator is at the keyboard — flagged for the operator's call. Fix pass follows.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Round 2 fix pass COMPLETE (ff0d3a3f; changelog mirror follows). All three children closed with tree-verified results. The terminal-injection hole #777 left open is closed on all three surfaces the lenses named, with the falsifiers the quality lens showed missing now real. Gates: 130 tests pass / 0 fail (status conduct suite 25 -> 30), clippy zero, fmt clean, mdatron verify clean. Round 3 (verify the round-2 fixes, re-decide the stop) dispatches next — and, per the conduct recommendation carried on this issue, it runs synchronously under the live session rather than detached, since three consecutive background dispatches were mauled by host sleep or connection drops and the container-backed vehicle is Layer 8's, not yet built.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Closed as lifecycle cleanup (Layer-3 compliance audit, 2026-07-28). This phase-3 round's findings were fix-closed IN PLACE without phase-4 routing — the recorded deviation (#806/#808), forward-only, standing on that record. The round's terminal-safety fixes landed and were then SUPERSEDED by the Layer-3 rebuild (#813) under the ratified Terminal output safety requirement (#807); their tests became its verification architecture. Round issue left open at the time; closed now.
